```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# Read in data
afl_fantasy_2015_2024_data <- readRDS("../../../Data/afl_fantasy_2015_2024_data.rds")
afl_fantasy_2025_data <- readRDS("../../../Data/afl_fantasy_2025_data.rds")

# Combine data
combined_stats <- bind_rows(afl_fantasy_2015_2024_data, afl_fantasy_2025_data)

# For 2020 data, make tackles 1.25 times more than the original value
combined_stats <- combined_stats |>
  mutate(tackles = ifelse(season_name == "2020", tackles * 1.25, tackles))

# Convert UTC time to local Australian time and classify day/night games
# Most AFL games are in Melbourne time (AEDT/AEST), so we'll use approximate conversion
# Day games: before 5:30 PM local time, Night games: 5:30 PM or later
combined_stats <- combined_stats |>
  mutate(
    start_time_local = as.POSIXct(start_time_utc) + hours(11), # Approximate Australian time
    local_hour = hour(start_time_local),
    game_time = case_when(
      local_hour < 17.5 ~ "Day",
      local_hour >= 17.5 ~ "Night",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

# Get all home team total tackles
home_team_tackles <-
  combined_stats |>
  filter(player_team == home_team) |> 
  select(match, round, season_name, home_team, tackles, temperature, venue, weather_category, game_time) |> 
  group_by(match, round, season_name, home_team, temperature, venue, weather_category, game_time) |>
  summarise(home_team_total_tackles = sum(tackles, na.rm = TRUE))

# Get all away team total tackles
away_team_tackles <-
  combined_stats |>
  filter(player_team == away_team) |> 
  select(match, round, season_name, away_team, tackles, temperature, venue, weather_category, game_time) |> 
  group_by(match, round, season_name, away_team, temperature, venue, weather_category, game_time) |>
  summarise(away_team_total_tackles = sum(tackles, na.rm = TRUE))

# Join
team_tackles <- left_join(home_team_tackles, away_team_tackles, by = c("match", "round", "season_name", "temperature", "venue", "weather_category", "game_time"))
```

# Analyse how tackles are distributed between home and away teams

```{r}
# Plot home tackles vs away tackles
team_tackles |>
  ggplot(aes(x = home_team_total_tackles, y = away_team_total_tackles)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Home Team Tackles vs Away Team Tackles",
       x = "Home Team Total Tackles",
       y = "Away Team Total Tackles")
```

# Analyse total tackles by venue

```{r}
# Get total tackles by venue
venue_tackles <-
  team_tackles |>
  mutate(total_tackles = home_team_total_tackles + away_team_total_tackles) |>
  group_by(venue) |>
  summarise(
    games_played = n(),
    median_tackles_per_match = median(total_tackles, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  arrange(desc(median_tackles_per_match)) |> 
  filter(games_played >= 10)

venue_tackles
```

```{r}
# Box plot of tackles by venue (venues with 10+ games)
team_tackles |>
  mutate(total_tackles = home_team_total_tackles + away_team_total_tackles) |>
  group_by(venue) |>
  filter(n() >= 10) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(venue, total_tackles, FUN = median), y = total_tackles)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Total Tackles per Match by Venue",
       subtitle = "Venues with 10+ games played",
       x = "Venue",
       y = "Total Tackles per Match") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Bar chart showing median tackles by venue
venue_tackles |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(venue, median_tackles_per_match), y = median_tackles_per_match)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Median Tackles per Match by Venue",
       subtitle = "Venues with 10+ games played",
       x = "Venue",
       y = "Median Tackles per Match") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
  summarise(
    games_played = n(),
    median_tackles_per_match = median(total_tackles, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  arrange(desc(median_tackles_per_match)) |> 
  filter(games_played >= 10)

weather_tackles
```

```{r}
# Box plot of tackles by weather category
team_tackles |>
  mutate(total_tackles = home_team_total_tackles + away_team_total_tackles) |>
  group_by(weather_category) |>
  filter(n() >= 10) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(weather_category, total_tackles, FUN = median), y = total_tackles)) +
```


# Analyse total tackles by day vs night games (excluding Marvel Stadium)

```{r}
# Filter out Marvel Stadium (indoor venue) and analyse day vs night
day_night_tackles <-
  team_tackles |>
  filter(venue != "Marvel Stadium") |>
  mutate(total_tackles = home_team_total_tackles + away_team_total_tackles) |>
  group_by(game_time) |>
  summarise(
    games_played = n(),
    mean_tackles_per_match = mean(total_tackles, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_tackles_per_match = median(total_tackles, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_tackles_per_match = sd(total_tackles, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(median_tackles_per_match))

day_night_tackles
```

```{r}
# Box plot comparing day vs night tackles (excluding Marvel Stadium)
team_tackles |>
  filter(venue != "Marvel Stadium") |>
  mutate(total_tackles = home_team_total_tackles + away_team_total_tackles) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = game_time, y = total_tackles, fill = game_time)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Day" = "gold", "Night" = "navy")) +
  labs(title = "Total Tackles per Match: Day vs Night Games",
       subtitle = "Excluding Marvel Stadium (indoor venue)",
       x = "Game Time",
       y = "Total Tackles per Match",
       fill = "Game Time") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Density plot comparing day vs night tackles (excluding Marvel Stadium)
team_tackles |>
  filter(venue != "Marvel Stadium") |>
  mutate(total_tackles = home_team_total_tackles + away_team_total_tackles) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total_tackles, fill = game_time)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Day" = "gold", "Night" = "navy")) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Total Tackles: Day vs Night Games",
       subtitle = "Excluding Marvel Stadium (indoor venue)",
       x = "Total Tackles per Match",
       y = "Density",
       fill = "Game Time") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Statistical test for difference between day and night tackles
day_night_data <- team_tackles |>
  filter(venue != "Marvel Stadium") |>
  mutate(total_tackles = home_team_total_tackles + away_team_total_tackles)

# T-test
t_test_result <- t.test(total_tackles ~ game_time, data = day_night_data)
cat("T-test results for Day vs Night tackles:\n")
cat("p-value:", t_test_result$p.value, "\n")
cat("Day games mean:", t_test_result$estimate[1], "\n")
cat("Night games mean:", t_test_result$estimate[2], "\n")
```
